model_annotation: The provided image displays two separate line plots, both illustrating the BLEU score as a function of a varying parameter. The left plot shows BLEU score on the y-axis against the parameter α on the x-axis, with α ranging from 0.1 to 0.9 in increments of 0.2. The BLEU score starts at 28.0 when α is 0.1, increases to a peak of 28.5 at α = 0.5, and then decreases to 28.1 at α = 0.9. The right plot shows BLEU score on the y-axis against the parameter p on the x-axis, with p ranging from 0.05 to 0.45 in increments of 0.1. The BLEU score begins at 28.3 when p is 0.05, rises to a peak of 28.5 at p = 0.15, then declines to 28.4 at p = 0.25, rises again to 28.45 at p = 0.35, and finally decreases slightly to 28.4 at p = 0.45. Both plots use a solid blue line with circular markers to represent the data points.
